process EASYPQP_CONVERT {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/easypqp:0.1.60--pyhdfd78af_1'
        : 'quay.io/biocontainers/easypqp:0.1.60--pyhdfd78af_1'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(id_file), path(spectra)
    path unimod

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.psmpkl") , emit: psmpkl
    tuple val(meta), path("*.peakpkl"), emit: peakpkl
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('easypqp'), eval("easypqp --version | sed 's/.*version //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_easypqp

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def unimod_arg = unimod ? "--unimod ${unimod}" : ''
    // Output basenames are derived from the spectra file by easypqp and must not be
    // changed: easypqp library pairs peak and PSM pickles to runs by this basename.
    """
    export MPLCONFIGDIR=\$PWD/.matplotlib
    export XDG_CACHE_HOME=\$PWD/.cache
    mkdir -p \$MPLCONFIGDIR \$XDG_CACHE_HOME

    easypqp convert \\
        --pepxml ${id_file} \\
        --spectra ${spectra} \\
        ${unimod_arg} \\
        ${args}
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = spectra.baseName
    """
    touch ${prefix}.psmpkl
    touch ${prefix}.peakpkl
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/easypqp/convert"
description: "Convert peptide identifications (pepXML or idXML) and the matching spectra\
  \ (mzML, mzXML or MGF) into EasyPQP PSM and peak pickle files for spectral library\
  \ generation."
keywords:
- "proteomics"
- "spectral library"
- "dia"
- "pepxml"
- "idxml"
- "mzml"
tools:
- easypqp:
    description: "Python package to generate spectral libraries for data-independent\
      \ acquisition (DIA) proteomics from DDA search results."
    homepage: "https://github.com/grosenberger/easypqp"
    documentation: "https://github.com/grosenberger/easypqp"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/grosenberger/easypqp"
    licence:
    - "BSD-3-Clause"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - id_file:
      type: "file"
      description: "Peptide identifications for one MS run. Either a pepXML file (`*.pep.xml`,\
        \ e.g. interact-*.pep.xml from the\nTrans-Proteomic Pipeline; PSMs without\
        \ PeptideProphet/iProphet probabilities are ignored) or an OpenMS idXML\n\
        file (`*.idXML`, any score type; a q-value or PEP score is used when present).\
        \ The idXML route is used by\nnf-core/mhcquant with Comet/Percolator results.\n"
      pattern: "*.{pep.xml,pepxml,idXML}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3655"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3764"
  - spectra:
      type: "file"
      description: "Spectra of the same MS run in mzML, mzXML or MGF (timsTOF) format.\
        \ The output pickles are named after the\nbasename of this file.\n"
      pattern: "*.{mzML,mzXML,mgf}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3244"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3654"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3651"
- unimod:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional UniMod XML file used to annotate modifications. EasyPQP's\
      \ bundled UniMod is used when omitted."
    pattern: "*.xml"
    ontologies:
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2332"
output:
  psmpkl:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.psmpkl':
        type: "file"
        description: "Pickled pandas DataFrame with the parsed PSMs. Named after the\
          \ spectra file basename, which easypqp library uses to pair PSMs and peaks."
        pattern: "*.psmpkl"
  peakpkl:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.peakpkl':
        type: "file"
        description: "Pickled pandas DataFrame with the annotated fragment ion peaks.\
          \ Named after the spectra file basename, which easypqp library uses to pair\
          \ PSMs and peaks."
        pattern: "*.peakpkl"
  versions_easypqp:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - easypqp:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - easypqp --version | sed 's/.*version //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - easypqp:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - easypqp --version | sed 's/.*version //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@jonasscheid"
maintainers:
- "@jonasscheid"
